title: HECM Tenure Payment Count on a New Scheduled Payment: the HUD Five-Year Minimum
content:
Cedarline applies the HUD five-year minimum to the payment count of a new Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) scheduled payment set on a change onto monthly scheduled payments:

- for a tenure-based plan (HECM Tenure Payment Plan or HECM Modified Tenure Plan) where twelve times the difference between 100 years and the borrower's age is below 60, the payment count is 60;
- for any other tenure-based plan it is twelve times that difference;
- otherwise — a term-based plan — it is the requested term in months on the request.

The borrower's age is the youngest borrower's age at closing plus the whole years from the closing date to the handling date; 100 years is the tenure age horizon the tenure-based plans carry.

**Both sides of the minimum.**

| Borrower's age | Twelve times the difference from 100 | Payment count on a tenure-based plan |
|---|---|---|
| 93 | 84 | 84 |
| 95 | 60 | 60 |
| 97 | 36 | 60 |

*Term-based case (hypothetical):* a Modified Term request for 36 months has a payment count of 36, whatever the borrower's age.
